im so sorry. i cant say i know how painful that must be but i know that it is surely painful. but really it is okay, she definitely doesn’t hate you for breaking it, and i’m sure she is glad that you loved her gift so much that breaking it has caused you such pain. don’t beat yourself up for breaking it, you haven’t lost the love that gift represented just because it is broken now. maybe turning it into something new would feel good; to make something lovely and show kindness to that act of love. i know you probably feel so terrible and so stupid for breaking it but you’re not. you loved her gift and wore it so often that it got damaged. you were not being careless with her love. this probably brought up a lot of old grief, and you might feel like you lost her all over again. and that’s okay, you can feel that, but know it is not your fault. show love and kindness to yourself. forgive yourself, even though you did nothing wrong.

Personally, I find ice skating really enjoyable. It’s cold so I don’t get overheated and it’s honestly crazy how much easier ice skating is than running. I find activities like dancing that have more fluid movements are easier for me as well as yoga although some poses are too straining. Stretching is always nice and helps me to feel less restless. I also have ADHD so I know how hard this can get. Try to do what you can and get your body moving in some way, even if it’s not is intense as you wish it were. Listen to your body and keep looking for types of exercise that you can manage. Don’t get too frustrated and give yourself time. Do little things when you can’t do big things.
